title: {p} Enchilada Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook the {p} with the {spice} until browned, then add the {v} and cook until soft.
Stir in half the {sauce}, then roll or layer the mixture in the {s} in a baking dish.
Pour over the rest of the {sauce}, cover and bake 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbling and at least 165°F / 74°C in the center.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with something fresh, like cabbage or avocado.
tip: Fill it with extra veg and beans, and use half the cheese.
